notes: The author called it a finding game and the map's whole job is hiding characters to touch, so Adventure leads and Scavenger Hunt is the preset; Roleplay & Avatar Sim is named second because unlocking playable characters with their own advantages is avatar collection, though it contributes no option the finding loop does not already cover. Shape is world-open: the answers describe one small varied cartoon world searched in any order, not chapters or a directed route. The ten characters are collectible-nodes and alcove-secret is what makes them findable rather than merely placed, while landmark-focal gives a small varied map enough orientation to search systematically; I dropped tracker-quest because the unlock roster reads as UI, not a board in the world. With no user to ask I assumed the characters sit in outdoor nooks rather than inside enterable buildings, which keeps this on P0.
